title: rumex maritimus subsp. rossicus
intro: Rumex maritimus subsp. rossicus, commonly known as the seaside plantain, is a type of plant that belongs to the polygonaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rumex maritimus subsp. rossicus include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties.
